description: RuvNet Brain 5: one prompt hook that prints the health line, and the optional write guard's tool-use hook (it does nothing unless the user ran `ruvnet-brain guard on`; it has no || fallback, because its exit 2 is how it refuses a write). Each first word is the plug-in's own launcher by absolute path (never a bare node); they start nothing else and read no project file. The installed copy names the launcher under the brain home.

hooks.command: "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/rb5" hook || echo "[RuvNet Brain] DOWN: Node could not run. Search is unavailable. Fix: run 'node -v' in a terminal; reinstall Node if it fails."
